title: Agent Skill Manifest
description: Sibling manifest.json for an Agent Skill. It is the skill's PACKAGE record and dependency graph, resolved by the skills CLI: version identity, skills-only dependencies expressed as package references (path for local, repo + ref for remote), and runtime capabilities. The context graph lives in SKILL.md frontmatter, not here.

$schema.description: JSON Schema id this manifest conforms to.

name.description: Skill name; must match the parent directory and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

source.description: Origin of THIS skill: file:<path> when local, git:<host/owner/repo>@<ref> when published.

dependencies.description: Skill dependencies only (package refs). Tools go in capabilities.

capabilities.description: Runtime capabilities the skill needs. A need, not an implementation.

type.description: Dependencies are skills. Tools are capabilities.

path.description: Workspace-relative path for a local (vendored) dependency.

ref.description: Pinned commit or content hash for a remote dependency.

integrity.description: Content hash for a remote dependency.

allOf.description: A local dependency needs a path; a remote one a repo.
A remote dependency must be pinned.

probe.description: Shell command that exits 0 when the capability is available.
